span.p:
SLA Escalation Agent
Model: Haiku
(lightweight, frequent runs)
Tools:
- Ticket System Query
- Slack/Email Alerts
- Compliance Logger
Logic:
1. Query all open tickets
2. Calculate time remaining
3. Check vs SLA deadline
